definition: Candidate Vietnamese-L1 interference items for human review before any promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS. Each entry is a non-native English production (vietlish) paired with its natural target (natural), the VN source pattern with diacritics (sourcePattern), and a contextual sentence. A handful of entries are deliberate natural 'control' anchors (flagged in sourcePattern) so reviewers can confirm the detector abstains on natural usage.
